simpleoptmemory.guide.page.1.title: Simple Opt Memory
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.1: Memory optimizations; so far the switch, its config and mod detection.
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.2.title: Steps back for known mods
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.2: config/simpleoptmemory.json has a mode per area (auto, ours, theirs, off).
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.3.title: Steps back for known mods
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.3: In auto, FerriteCore wins the block-state tables and our part stays off; ours next to it is refused, since both change the same constructors.
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.4.title: Steps back for known mods
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.4: Another mod hooking the same classes switches the area off at start (target check, conflictScan). The log also names ModernFix when installed (model loading is a later area).
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.5.title: Shared block-state tables
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.5: Block states that hold the same property values (for example every stair block facing east) share one value array instead of one each,
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.6.title: Shared block-state tables
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.6: blocks with the same properties share one key array, and states with the same
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.7.title: Shared block-state tables
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.7: face-support pattern share one table. Only arrays that are never written are shared, with exact identity of their entries, so the game behaves the same;
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.8.title: Shared block-state tables
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.8: the log reports how many arrays were shared and the memory saved.
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.9.title: Commands
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.9: /simpleoptmemory config shows and changes every option of config/simpleoptmemory.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.10.title: Commands
simpleoptmemory.guide.page.10: The file is read once while the game starts, so a change is saved at once but takes effect after a restart (each answer says so). Permission level 2. The same file is also reachable as /simpleclient simpleoptmemory.
